outcome: Gut microbiota composition at 1 week, 1 month, and 1 year of age
cohort: 700 children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood (2010) (COPSAC(2010)) cohort
finding: While cesarean section delivery was associated with altered gut microbiota composition early in life, the increased risk of asthma by age 6 was only observed in children whose gut microbiota at 1 year still retained a cesarean section signature.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with altered gut microbiota composition at 1 week and 1 month of age, but by 1 year, only minor differences persisted compared to vaginal delivery.
